segments: In December 2010, 13-year-old Hailey Dunn disappeared from Colorado City, Texas.
Weeks later, Shawn Adkins, her mother's boyfriend, took a lie detector test.
He told the examiner she might be in Scurry County.
When they asked again where she was, he refused to answer.
Two years later, Hailey was found in Scurry County.
He has always denied hurting her.
“I would never do nothing to that little girl. I love her with all my heart.”
In 2021, he was charged with her murder.
Two years after that, the state dropped the case.
The internet thinks this one was solved.
The post about his arrest got thousands of upvotes.
The post about his release got one.
And what the state admits it never tested.
Here are ten things you probably don't know.
